candidate.name: archaeopteryx-js
candidate.notes: Full viewer application driven imperatively (launch/destroy); d3 7.9.0 and phyloxml 1.1.7 put on globalThis for the UMD file; panel collapsed by default.

tipClick.how: no click callback in the library; adapter listens for DOM clicks and maps them to the node (d3 datum or layout coordinates): adapter-derived

internalNodeClick.how: same workaround; internal nodes without a label are found by layout coordinates (rectangular only)

branchClick.how: no branch elements (branches are batched into a few paths); clicks on a branch hit the nearest node

hover.how: library shows its own tooltip, no callback; adapter-derived hover events from a DOM mousemove hit test

descendantTipsInPayload.how: the library has no payload; tip sets are computed by the adapter from the shared TreeModel (source adapter-derived)

cladeColouring.how: sets the phyloXML node.color on the library's live node objects and forces a redraw with applyViewState({}); the library has no colour-a-clade API

highlightTip.how: search box A via applyViewState({searchA: regex on node name}); the library bolds the hits, adds a halo and dims everything else; no per-tip style API

focusTip.how: search A + the library's documented Ctrl+Shift+E and Ctrl+G shortcuts dispatched on document; no focus/zoom-to API

tipAsLink.how: tip labels are SVG <text>; the adapter overlays <a href data-tip-id> over the visible labels (up to 400), re-positioned on each redraw

customColumns.how: only through built-ins: numeric columns become heat-map columns (>=2), text columns become label text or Color-by; no custom cell renderers

alignmentColumn.how: mol_seq on tip nodes; built-in alignment track (windowed, with conservation bar or sequence logo)

radialLayout.how: layout: 'circular' (also 'unrooted'); heat map as rings, alignment track rectangular only

branchLengthToggle.how: applyViewState({display: 'phylogram' | 'cladogram'}); a tree drawn to scale needs > 50% positive lengths

scaleBar.how: scale bar always drawn for phylograms; showScaleAxis adds an axis (time axis for dated trees)

darkTheme.how: library has its own light/dark switch (button, localStorage 'aptx-panel-theme'); adapter clicks it; the dark palette is the library's, not GBIF's

cssTokens.how: no token contract; adapter overrides default-coloured SVG fills/strokes with CSS !important selectors and re-points the panel's --p-* custom properties

multipleInstances.how: module singleton: a second launch() replaces the first (README: "One viewer per page")

cleanUnmount.how: viewer.destroy() removes DOM, body-level tooltip/menu, resize and key/wheel listeners

controlledState.how: view state both ways (applyViewState / onViewChange); no selection, viewport or colour setters

zoomToFit.how: fits on launch and on window resize; Ctrl+0 and a panel button refit

overviewOrMinimap.how: built-in overview miniature (always shown, cannot be switched off by config)

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.
